item: Row 367: the Climate tab and the source-qualification line follow a language switch
key_paths: src/static/app-climate.js; src/static/app-ai-tools.js; src/static/app-boot.js; configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt; configs/innerhtml_unescaped_sinks.txt; tests/climate_live_node_test.js; tests/test_climate_live.py; tests/ai_tools_live_node_test.js; tests/test_ai_tools_live.py; tests/test_clickthrough_b9_fixes.py
summary: Six app-climate.js renderers and qualifyBulkStart leave the frozen list. A climate view is built bare per read and its parts are held (text and buttons, OWID labels and figure names, chart notes, place form and result, status line); charts are redrawn from their held points by climateChartsRepaint from app-boot's one langchange listener; typed station and place fields survive a switch, a new read draws stored values; consent order unchanged. Qualification: the line is one render; a run's tally was replaced at once by the finally block's status read and is now kept for that read (shown once, also when the read fails); the langchange listener no longer re-reads the line (it dropped the tally). The place view's own read no longer writes under another view when it answers late. No new strings.
